description: Creates a new workspace for the signed-in account, with the account as its administrator, and returns { companyId, slug, trial, choosePlanUrl, setup }. The slug is the value of the workspace argument for work in the new workspace; trial is true when it starts with the free trial (only the first workspace a login creates does). Without a trial the workspace cannot be used until a plan is chosen, and choosePlanUrl is the link where the user chooses it (null with a trial). With a description, Mate plans and builds the whole workspace on the server, the same setup the app's onboarding runs: setup.status planning means it started and the workspace setup status reports its progress; notStarted carries the reason, for example a workspace without a plan or a plan without Mate, and leaves an empty workspace. Without a description the workspace starts empty and setup is null. Cloud only; needs a verified email address and an OAuth connection approved for the whole account, allows at most 3 new workspaces per account in any 24 hours, and follows the terms the account accepted.

description.description: One or two sentences about the business in the owner's words: what it does and for whom. When given, Mate builds the workspace from it on the server: lists, fields, pipeline, views, dashboard and Knowledge Base

displayLanguage.description: App language of the account in the new workspace; system follows the browser. Defaults to the language already in use

exampleRecords.description: Whether Mate adds example records (default true)

mainSteps.description: Pipeline steps of the main tracked work, in order

name.description: Workspace name, usually the company name

purpose.description: What the workspace keeps track of

teamSize.description: How many people will work in it: solo (just one person), small (2-5), medium (6-20), large (more than 20)

workWith.description: Who the business works with: clients (ongoing relationships), customers (one-off buyers) or ownWork
